history.summary: A 99LH 4BR EC (Heron Bay, D19 Upper Serangoon/Hougang) at $1.988M / $1,251 psf for a large 1,589 sqft unit. The $1,251 psf sits mid-range of recent $1,202-$1,557 project transactions and the arena Elo is strong (1,478), but a near-$2M 4BR with LRT-only access (1.24km) in OCR Hougang is a niche, transit-dependent exit.
history.rating_rationale: Web check: Heron Bay is a 394-unit privatised EC (2016) transacting $1,202-$1,557 psf over the last year — so the $1,251 psf asking is fair/mid-range, not a discount. The strong arena record (287-124, Elo 1,478) reflects the value quantum and large EC format. But there is no URA appreciation data, the unit relies on Kangkar LRT (1.24km, not MRT), and a $1.988M 4BR is a family-only pool at the upper edge of the deep band. EC liquidity is decent once privatised, but the transit gap and format keep this Neutral.
red_flags: LRT-only (1.24km Kangkar), no MRT — transit-dependent OCR Hougang
$1.99M 4BR — family-only resale pool at the band's upper edge
No URA appreciation/transaction data to anchor upside
catalysts: 394-unit privatised EC — reasonable liquidity for the segment
Fair $1,251 psf within the recent transacted range
Hougang/Serangoon mature-estate amenities; Cross Island Line spillover in D19
